scientific_integrity: Analytical all-horizon proof via exact conditional second moments; reproducible finite exact-rational checks are diagnostics, not infinite proof. Prior-literature originality qualified by residual priority uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic, fixed four-coordinate SPD pair-coupled quadratic, simultaneous pre-update diagonal gradient steps, independent stationary balanced batches of size two; no universal sampling prescription for arbitrary Hessians or initial states, no claim of improved geometric rate or cost.
title: Exact coupling-invariant Euclidean risk and state-dependent batch-optimal objective in four-coordinate descent
